
Only sort of.
An explicit double negative, like ''mi na na nelci'', is a positive.
This means that, if a sentence like ''mi na nelci'' is followed by ''na go'i'', you're still saying ''mi na nelci''
But a negative answer to a negative question, thus:
xu mi na nelci
na go'i
is still negative.
Similar to the confusion with [[na nei|na nei]].
''..no! ..nooooooooooooooooooo!''
To give an always-positive answer, use ''ja'a''. It's a simpler system than English, where you have to notice the form of the question when answering "yes" or "no".
''na go'i'' is always negative.''ja'a go'i'' is always positive.
